title: Booking and Intake
body:
## Booking and Intake

> **Demo content.** Fictional sample material for QA Lantern Wiki testing. It is not real guidance.

### What a visitor can bring

Each visitor may bring one item, no heavier than 8 kg. Last intake is 13:00.

### What to record

Record the item description, reported problem and visitor consent.

### Transport and responsibility

Visitors retain responsibility for transporting their items.

### Cost of parts

Parts costing up to $25 per repair are covered by the cafe. See [Parts and Expenses](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.ba9294d940aa471bb5996608) for approval over $25, receipts and Tuesday ordering.

title: Escalation and Incidents
body:
## Escalation and Incidents

> **Demo content.** Fictional sample material for QA Lantern Wiki testing. It is not real guidance.

### Stop work first

Stop work immediately after an injury or unsafe incident.

### Report and record

Tell Priya and record the incident before the session ends.

### Parts exceptions

For parts exceptions contact Mateo.

### No guarantees
The cafe does not promise that every item can be repaired.

### Related reading

**Tool Safety** lists the prevention rules; **Parts and Expenses** covers the $25 limit.

### Related pages

- [Tool Safety](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.c97eedc1ba15494b9f071a1a)
- [Parts and Expenses](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.ba9294d940aa471bb5996608)

title: Parts and Expenses
body:
## Parts and Expenses

> **Demo content.** Fictional sample material for QA Lantern Wiki testing. It is not real guidance.

### Parts budget

The cafe covers parts costing up to $25 per repair.

### Over $25

Purchases over $25 require coordinator Mateo's approval before ordering.

### Receipts and ordering

Keep every receipt. Parts orders are placed on Tuesdays.

### Exceptions

For parts exceptions contact Mateo; **Escalation and Incidents** lists the same contact route.

### Related pages

title: Tool Safety
body:
## Tool Safety

> **Demo content.** Fictional sample material for QA Lantern Wiki testing. It is not real guidance.

### Before you open anything

Unplug electrical items before opening them.

### Electrical repairs

A qualified electrical volunteer must approve an electrical repair before the item is returned.

### Batteries

Damaged lithium batteries are never accepted; refer visitors to the council recycling desk.

### If something goes wrong

Stop work immediately after an injury or unsafe incident, then follow **Escalation and Incidents**.

### Related pages

- [Volunteer Onboarding](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.cb4dd9c45c1d49e2b8a0f214)
- [Escalation and Incidents](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.46db2ee0a50c491681d706e0)

title: Volunteer Onboarding
body:
## Volunteer Onboarding

> **Demo content.** Fictional sample material for QA Lantern Wiki testing. It is not real guidance.

### Before you repair anything

New volunteers attend a 30-minute safety induction with Priya, the safety lead, before repairing anything.

### Your first two sessions

Buddy with an experienced volunteer for the first two sessions.

### Who can volunteer

Volunteers must be 18 or older.

### Related reading

**Tool Safety** covers the rules you use every session. **Escalation and Incidents** explains what to do if something goes wrong.

### Related pages

- [Tool Safety](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.c97eedc1ba15494b9f071a1a)

title: Welcome
body:
## Welcome to the Lantern Repair Cafe

> **Demo content.** This page is fictional sample material for QA Lantern Wiki testing. It is not real repair guidance.

**Where and when:** Lantern Repair Cafe runs on Saturdays from 10:00 to 14:00 at Cedar Hall.

### What happens at the cafe

Volunteers help repair small household items. Walk-ins are welcome; repairs are free, and donations are optional.

### Start here

Visitors should read [Booking and Intake](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.663a60957b70456784be28bb) before bringing an item.

New helpers start with [Volunteer Onboarding](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.cb4dd9c45c1d49e2b8a0f214), then read [Tool Safety](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.c97eedc1ba15494b9f071a1a).

### All topic pages

- [Volunteer Onboarding](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.cb4dd9c45c1d49e2b8a0f214) - 30-minute induction with Priya, buddy for the first two sessions, volunteers 18+
- [Tool Safety](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.c97eedc1ba15494b9f071a1a) - unplug before opening, electrical sign-off before return, no damaged lithium batteries
- [Escalation and Incidents](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.46db2ee0a50c491681d706e0) - stop work after an injury, tell Priya and record it before the session ends
- [Parts and Expenses](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.ba9294d940aa471bb5996608) - parts up to $25, Mateo approves anything over, keep receipts, Tuesday orders
- [Booking and Intake](/tracks/n.Track.ec71815ba0e94ea1b8f4d184?entry=n.Entry.663a60957b70456784be28bb) - one item per visitor up to 8 kg, last intake 13:00, record description, problem and consent
